items.title: Steal My Food Itinerary: 3 Days on Prince Edward Island
items.content_html:
Recently I spent a few days exploring Prince Edward Island, a place that embraces its local foodways with gusto. There’s a complex history here, with roots in Indigenous Mi’kmaq, Acadian, Irish, Scottish, and other cultures.
